description: Lines that serve an ÖBB station according to the plan but that HAFAS does not show at the moment, mostly because of construction. Used only by the report-only line check (stage 3, scripts/check_feed_lines.py). An entry applies up to and including 'until'; null means the end is open. Expired entries are ignored and logged so they get reviewed.

stations.name: Wien Mitte-Landstraße
stations.reason: Stammstrecke Praterstern – Hauptbahnhof/St. Marx closed (Wiener Linien: 'S-Bahn-Stammstrecke (Phase 2)', 2026-09-07 to October 2027). REX1 and REX3 stop on both sides of the closure even at small stations (Traisengasse, Matzleinsdorfer Platz); REX7 stops at St. Marx.

stations.name: Wien Rennweg
stations.reason: Stammstrecke Praterstern – Hauptbahnhof/St. Marx closed (Phase 2, 2026-09-07 to October 2027); see Wien Mitte-Landstraße.

stations.name: Wien Quartier Belvedere
stations.reason: Stammstrecke Praterstern – Hauptbahnhof closed (Phase 2, 2026-09-07 to October 2027). The S7 turns off at Rennweg towards St. Marx and does not serve Quartier Belvedere.

stations.name: Wien Hütteldorf
stations.reason: Verbindungsbahn: rail replacement bus for the S80 (Wiener Linien: 'ÖBB-Ersatzbus für 80'). End open.

stations.name: Wien Speising
stations.reason: Verbindungsbahn: HAFAS shows only the rail replacement bus BusSV910 (2026-09-26). End open.

stations.name: Himberg
stations.reason: HAFAS shows no departures at either stop (sample dates 2026-09-29 and 2026-11-03), cause open; the neighbours Lanzendorf-Rannersdorf and Gramatneusiedl have the S60. Review at the timetable change.
